title: Quitting winnable contests? The calibration of resignation in online chess and surrender in League of Legends: preregistrations, code, and pilot summaries
description:
This version adds a second preregistration (prereg/preregistration_2_v1.0.md, registered 2026-11-19): hypotheses K1 to K7 on the move-level hazard of resignation in online chess ("the strong quit more, not better"), derived from exploratory analyses of September and June 2026 and to be tested on July and August 2026, which had not been downloaded at registration. It also adds the frozen analysis code for that test (code/chess_hazard.py, code/chess_stage_a.py) and the deviations log up to D6.

Earlier content: preregistration v1.0 (registered 2026-11-15), pilot scripts, the confirmatory League of Legends collector, and aggregate pilot outputs for a study of how much winning chance players give up when they resign (online chess, Lichess) or surrender (League of Legends). Raw Riot API data are not included.
